title: The page loads under its script budget, still shows the date, and the measure is unchanged
hurried: The page loads slowly. Fix it.

files.scripts/size.py:
import pathlib
import re
import sys

page = pathlib.Path('index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
total = sum(pathlib.Path(src).stat().st_size for src in re.findall(r'<script[^>]*src="([^"]+)"', page))
print(f'{total} bytes of script on first load')
sys.exit(0 if total <= int(sys.argv[1]) else 1)
